# AT581x radar reference

The register sequence in `firmware/src/board_sensors.cpp` is adapted from [Espressif's AT581x driver](https://github.com/espressif/esp-iot-solution/tree/6958385313b0e4fc1f3de259b1d677fca7d7d236/components/sensors/radar/at581x).

SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023-2025 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The adaptation uses Arduino Wire, one bounded initialization transaction per main-loop iteration, explicit RF enable, a nonblocking two-second self-test wait and cached GPIO observations. Default threshold, gain, power and pulse timing follow Espressif's initialization configuration. It does not change RF frequency or persist radar registers to flash. The full [Apache 2.0 license](es8311/LICENSE) is included.

BOX-3 SENSOR wiring is defined by Espressif's [board header](https://github.com/espressif/esp-box/blob/aae1b7a6d193d968cf53e42f291a60c4ca1c622c/components/bsp/include/bsp_board.h) and [sensor implementation](https://github.com/espressif/esp-box/blob/aae1b7a6d193d968cf53e42f291a60c4ca1c622c/components/bsp/src/boards/esp32_bsp_sensor.c): SDA 41, SCL 40, active-high radar output 21. The Arduino 7-bit radar address is 0x28.

The [MoreSense MS58 module datasheet distributed by Espressif](https://dl.espressif.com/AE/esp_iot_solution/MS58-3909S68U4-3V3-G-NLS-IIC%20Data%20Sheet%20V1.0.pdf) describes a 5.8 GHz Doppler motion sensor. Some BOX getting-started text instead says 2.4 GHz; this firmware does not depend on that description. The output indicates detected motion, not identity, distance or a guarantee that a motionless room occupant will be detected.
